The structure of DyCu3 crystallizes in the hexagonal space group P6_3/mmc (No. 194), with a unit cell containing 8 atoms (Dy2Cu6) distributed over 2 independent Wyckoff orbits. Geometry-only CrystalNN analysis identifies close-packed-like local arrangements for both sites: Cu centers have 12 geometric neighbors (8 Cu, 4 Dy), while Dy centers have 12 Cu neighbors, with neighbor distances ranging from about 2.70 to 2.86 Å. The periodic neighbor graph forms a single 3-dimensional component spanning all 8 sites. Validated polyhedron-sharing analysis shows Cu–Cu 12-vertex polyhedra exhibiting corner, edge, and face sharing, while Dy–Cu polyhedra share corners and edges.
